accepted_otf_program_metadata.role: Metadata in the three digest-admitted OpenType font programs; this is the font-program copyright evidence used by the repository notice.

installed_license_copy.copy_relation: The repository file was compared byte-for-byte with the installed source path at capture.
installed_license_copy.semantic_distinction: The installed package LICENSE.txt begins with a generic Copyright 2010, 2012 header. It preserves the observed license text; it does not replace or supersede the 2010–2019 copyright metadata in the three accepted OTF programs.

source_sans_pro.boundary: The three admitted OpenType font programs are covered by the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the package's LaTeX sources have a separate LPPL license. Exact copied license bytes do not authenticate the installed package, accepted font programs, a download, or upstream history.

latin_modern.version_and_copyright: Version 2.004; Copyright © 2003–2009 Bogusław Jackowski and Janusz M. Nowacki, on behalf of TeX Users Groups.

installed_license_copy.copy_relation: The repository file was compared byte-for-byte with the installed source path at capture.
installed_license_copy.semantic_distinction: This is the installed GUST Font License text. It states license conditions and a naming request; it is not the v2.004 content manifest and does not establish the identity or authenticity of a font program.

installed_manifest_copy.copy_relation: The repository file was compared byte-for-byte with the installed source path at capture.
installed_manifest_copy.semantic_distinction: This manifest records Latin Modern v2.004 authorship, copyright, naming, and package contents. It is not a substitute for the GUST license text and does not authenticate the installed font-program bytes or upstream history.

latin_modern.boundary: The two repository files preserve distinct installed evidence: license terms in one file and the v2.004 package manifest in the other. The accepted OpenType program hashes remain the byte acceptance authority.

license_evidence.redistribution_boundary: The repository does not vendor these five source font files. It does retain exact license and manifest evidence files. A generated PDF contains renderer-produced embedded subsets. This record is bounded provenance, not authentication or legal advice.

notice_expectations.source_sans_pro: Preserve the applicable copyright and OFL 1.1 notice when distributing Font Software in a scenario covered by that license.
notice_expectations.latin_modern: Preserve the applicable GUST Font License and manifest information, and evaluate its naming request if modifying or redistributing font programs.
notice_expectations.boundary: These are preservation prompts, not a legal determination for every downstream package or document.

source_sans_pro.status: The commit is an upstream release locator and observed correspondence. Exact installed-input hashes are the byte acceptance authority; the locator does not authenticate a download, distribution package, or the local files.

latin_modern_sans.status: The family/version names and exact hashes describe the installed font programs. No upstream repository byte identity, authenticated download, or package-chain proof is claimed.

execution_contract.output: A required new directory outside the repository; canonical PDFs cannot be selected
execution_contract.font_resolution: A generated standalone Fontconfig file lists only descriptor-captured copies of the five digest-bound fonts; PANGOCAIRO_BACKEND is fixed to fontconfig so macOS CoreText cannot bypass that inventory
execution_contract.license_evidence: Before rendering, the regenerator reads and verifies the three repository-retained license/manifest artifacts at their exact paths, sizes, and hashes. It revalidates those bytes before candidate publication and records their bounded roles in the generated receipt.
execution_contract.repeatability: Every derivative is rendered twice with independent Fontconfig homes and caches, then compared as raw bytes
execution_contract.pandoc: Not invoked and not part of the SVG-to-PDF path
execution_contract.publication: The command produces candidates and a receipt only; canonical acceptance remains a separate reviewed operation

claim_boundary: Same-invocation byte equality does not prove cross-host reproducibility, semantic or visual equivalence, accessibility, font-license compliance in every distribution scenario, authenticity of a package or upstream history, a legal determination, or canonical acceptance.
